title: Final Polarization
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the polarization of the reflected light as elliptically polarized.

title: Final Intensity Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the intensity ratio I''/I.

title: Use of Maxwell's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of Maxwell's equations to derive the boundary conditions for E and H fields.

title: Component Decomposition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly decompose the incident light into left-hand and right-hand circularly polarized components.

title: Reflection Coefficients
description: Optional Criteria: The student may derive the reflection coefficients for left and right circularly polarized light.

title: Mathematical Accuracy
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors in algebraic manipulation or sign mistakes in the equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
